verdict.rationale: Undermind is a SaaS research service with an enterprise API (docs-17, docs-44) and an official MCP server, so a buyer could fairly ask about scoped agent credentials. The evidence never mentions issuing API keys or tokens with restricted scopes or permissions. The MCP client-identification note (CIMD) concerns how a client identifies itself, not least-privilege credential scoping, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.
